about_the_game:
This DLC contains the following content:

  • Set【 Best Wishes】

Hairstyle【Beautiful Youth】 ：Chase your dreams and make the most of your youth.

Dress【Wishes Come True】： Clever mind, lucky heart – may good fortune always be your friend!

Socks【Splendid Prospect】：Snow-white socks and graceful steps – her future's looking bright as spring.

Shoes【Upward Everyday】：Riding high on success, taking in all life has to offer.

Hair Accessory【Good Fortune】：May fortune shine, happiness arrive, and troubles fade away!

Wristband【Long Fortune】：Here's to prosperity, status, long life, happiness, and wealth – may they all come rolling your way!

Back【Have a Good Night】：Her thoughts drift into sweet dreams, floating away with the clouds.

  • Underwear

【Tender Dreamland】：Her sleeping face in moonlight wears a smile, lost in beautiful dreams.

【Romantic City】：With heart full of romantic dreams, she blooms like a fresh flower.

Notes:

  • After purchasing, you need to log out and then log back into the game to receive the items in the [Dress-up Interface].

  • If you already have these items in the game, please do not make a duplicate purchase.

  • Please ensure that you update the game to the latest version to avoid being unable to obtain the DLC content after purchasing.

content_descriptors.notes: ZM Desktop Elf contains general mature content：Revealing outfits and some sexually suggestive character interactions
